title: NEXPEC Job Contract Variable Schema (JOB-TPL-001 v1.0)
description: JSON Schema that defines the variable substitution surface for JOB-TPL-001. Every Job Contract auto-generated by the NEXPEC platform must validate against this schema before electronic acceptance.

contract_id.description: Stable UUID of this generated contract instance.

job_id.description: FK to public.jobs.id on the Supabase backend.

version.description: Template version this contract was generated against.

language.description: Language of execution. The accepted-language version controls in case of translation conflict.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the contract was instantiated.

effective_at.description: Timestamp at which both Parties have electronically accepted; null until both acceptances are recorded.

organization_id.description: Set when the Client is acting under an Organization Seat (ORG-AGR-001 applies).

agency.description: Present when the Inspector is a Roster Inspector — the Agency, not the Inspector, is the counterparty to the Client (AGN-AGR-001 §3).

specialty.description: Free-text or controlled-vocabulary specialty descriptor (e.g., 'NDT — Ultrasonic', 'Pressure Vessel', 'Pipeline Coating').

compensation.description: Discriminated union over three compensation models. The 'model' field selects which sub-object is populated. Cross-model invariant: the 10% NEXPEC Platform Facilitation & Technology Fee is withheld at source at each funding/release event.

model.description: Compensation pattern. 'fixed' = single lump-sum funded upfront, released on acceptance. 'milestone' = sequenced or scheduled milestone payouts with independent funding and release per milestone. 'recurring' = periodic billing for ongoing engagements with rolling forward-funding.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. All amounts in compensation.* are expressed in the smallest unit of this currency (e.g., halalas for SAR, cents for USD/CAD).

rate_type.description: Pricing basis. 'retainer' is typical for 'recurring' model. 'per-milestone' is typical for 'milestone' model.

gross_amount_minor.description: Total gross value of the contract. For 'fixed' model, the single amount. For 'milestone' model, computed as the sum of milestones[].gross_amount_minor (platform-validated). For 'recurring' model, computed as recurring.period_amount_minor × recurring.total_periods when total_periods is non-null; null for open-ended recurring engagements.

pft_fee_minor.description: 10% of gross_amount_minor for 'fixed' model. For 'milestone' / 'recurring' the per-unit PFT fees are recorded on the milestones[]/recurring sub-objects; this top-level field carries the aggregate where computable.

net_payout_minor.description: gross_amount_minor − pft_fee_minor − (any in-Job adjustments). Carries aggregate for 'milestone' / 'recurring' where computable.

milestones.description: Required when model = 'milestone'. Each entry is a single milestone with its own funding, release trigger, and acceptance state. Order is determined by 'sequence'. A disputed milestone does not pause release of milestones already accepted (ESCROW-001 §3.5).

milestone_id.description: Stable identifier within this Job (e.g., 'M1', 'M2', 'M3'). Persisted in the acceptance ledger and dispute records.

sequence.description: 1-based ordinal. Lower-numbered milestones must be released (or formally cancelled) before higher-numbered milestones are funded — unless the Client elects to fund all milestones upfront in a single deposit.

pft_fee_minor.description: 10% of this milestone's gross_amount_minor, withheld at source on release.

trigger.description: What starts the 7-day review window for this milestone. 'client_acceptance' = Client manually approves a precondition; 'scheduled_date' = the milestone's scheduled_date is reached; 'inspector_marks_complete' (default) = Inspector marks the milestone done and uploads deliverables.

recurring.description: Required when model = 'recurring'. Defines the period, per-period amount, total duration (or null for open-ended), forward-funding requirement, and termination notice.

period_amount_minor.description: Gross amount Client pays per period. The 10% PFT Fee is withheld at source on each period release.

total_periods.description: Total number of billing periods. Null = open-ended; engagement runs until terminated by notice (see termination_notice_days).

funded_periods_ahead.description: Number of periods the Client must keep funded in rolling escrow at all times. NEXPEC sends Day-7 and Day-3 funding-reminders before each top-up obligation.

termination_notice_days.description: Days of advance written notice either Party must give to terminate the engagement. Funded periods within the notice window are honored; periods beyond are refunded less Stripe fees per ESCROW-001 §5.3.

periods_released.description: Running count of periods fully released. Maintained by the platform; used to compute next-funding-due and termination prorations.

allOf.description: Fixed model: require the single lump-sum amounts.
Milestone model: require a non-empty milestones array.
Recurring model: require the recurring sub-object.

review_window_days.description: Days the Client has to accept or dispute the delivery before auto-release under ESCROW-001 §3(c).

governing_law.description: Default 'QC-CCQ'. Overridden by an applicable Country Addendum or an ORG-AGR-001 Order Form.

forum.description: Default 'Montréal, Québec, Canada'. Override mechanics per ADDENDUM-FRAMEWORK-001.

country_addendum_applied.description: ID of an applicable Country Addendum (e.g., 'ADDENDUM-EU-001'), or null.

incorporated_documents.description: Tier-1, Tier-2, and Rider documents incorporated into this Job Contract. Snapshot of (id, version) at generation time so future amendments do not retroactively rebind accepted Jobs.
